<input type="text" id="comedian-search" class="site-search-input" placeholder="Search by name or style…" oninput="bcFilterComedians()">
</div>

{{< include _generated/comedians-content.qmd >}}

<p id="comedian-no-results" class="aside-note" style="display:none; text-align:center;">
No comedians match that search.
</p>

<div style="text-align:center; margin-top:1rem;">
<a class="cta-button" href="submit.qmd">Not listed yet? Add yourself →</a>
</div>

<script>
function bcFilterComedians() {
  var query = document.getElementById("comedian-search").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll(".comedian-card");
  var visibleCount = 0;
  cards.forEach(function(card) {
    var match = card.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1;
    card.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
    if (match) visibleCount++;
  });
  var noResults = document.getElementById("comedian-no-results");
  if (noResults) {
    noResults.style.display = (cards.length > 0 && visibleCount === 0) ? "block" : "none";
  }
}
</script>
